structural_change: Compiler-assigned writes and reads retain fixed TX3/RX1. Parallel GF2 CRC uses balanced XOR trees. Payload and command metadata are captured at assigned pins; ownership bookkeeping follows captured commands one edge later and never reschedules normal issue. Missing observed producer valid sets fault bit 7. Exact pin assignment 284543fb0; separate control root and four SRAM roots. Abort freezes the first fault; compiler drains and restarts the epoch explicitly.
